title: Tool 75 — Stablecoin Reserve & Peg Health Auditor
description: Client-side stablecoin reserve composition analyzer and peg stress-testing engine. Model reserve health for USDT, USDC, DAI, PYUSD, FDUSD, and EURC. Stress-test peg stability under devaluation shocks, bank-run scenarios, and liquidity crunches. Regulatory compliance mapping across MiCA, US GENIUS Act, SAMA, CBUAE, and MAS. Zero PII. No install.
